description: We are a passionate team exploring NASA open data to build innovative solutions for Earth and space challenges
summary:
1. Summary 
Our team, AstroDhaka26, developed a simple and interactive web tool to make NASA’s open space and Earth observation data easy for everyday people to understand. Raw satellite data is often too complex for students, farmers, and local communities to use directly. To solve this, we designed a clean interface that translates complex datasets into clear visual insights and practical information. Users can explore real-time environmental updates and space data without needing any technical background. By making NASA resources accessible on basic devices, our project helps communities make better, informed decisions in their daily lives. 
2. Project Details How It Works:
Our platform collects open datasets from NASA and presents them through a user-friendly dashboard. Instead of reading complicated charts or raw numbers, users get straightforward visual summaries and local insights.
Benefits & Impact:
Accessibility: Anyone with a basic smartphone or computer can understand space and climate data.
Tools & Technologies Used:
We built this project using standard web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and GitHub for version control, alongside open data APIs and resources provided by NASA.
Creativity & Design:
We focused on simplicity and speed. Rather than overloading the screen with heavy graphics, we created a lightweight layout that works smoothly even on slow internet connections.

How It Works:

Our platform collects open datasets from NASA and presents them through a user-friendly dashboard. Instead of reading complicated charts or raw numbers, users get straightforward visual summaries and local insights.

Benefits & Impact:

  • Accessibility: Anyone with a basic smartphone or computer can understand space and climate data.
  • Local Awareness: Helps students and community members track environmental changes and learn more about space science.

Tools & Technologies Used:

We built this project using standard web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and GitHub for version control, alongside open data APIs and resources provided by NASA.

Creativity & Design:

We focused on simplicity and speed. Rather than overloading the screen with heavy graphics, we created a lightweight layout that works smoothly even on slow internet connections.
